ongoing.title: Ongoing
ongoing.description: What your agents are investigating right now.

conversations.title: Conversations
conversations.description: Every question asked about your packages, with its answer.

packages.title: Packages
packages.description: The dependencies your agents can ask Cockpit Context about.

access.title: Access
access.description: How your coding agents connect, and how Cockpit Context reaches private repositories.

start.title: Getting started
start.description: Three steps to your agent’s first answer from real source code.

connect.title: Connect your coding agent
connect.body: Add Cockpit Context to Claude Code or Codex. Sign in with OAuth without copying a token.
connect.authenticate: Then run /mcp in Claude Code, pick cockpit-context and choose Authenticate.

package.title: Add a package
package.body: Add a dependency you want answers about, or let your agent propose one. Proposals wait for your approval.

ask.title: Ask a question
ask.body: Ask your agent about the package. Cockpit Context reads its source at the exact version you use, and the investigation shows up here while it runs.
ask.example: Use Cockpit Context to check how the dependency handles retries in the version we use.

live.title: Live investigations
live.idleBody: When an agent asks Cockpit Context a question, its investigation appears here while it works.

modelMissing.title: The model is not configured yet
modelMissing.admin: Set OPENROUTER_API_KEY and COCKPIT_CONTEXT_MODEL in the server's environment and restart it. Admin → Settings shows the current model configuration.
modelMissing.user: Ask your administrator to configure the model before asking a question.

access.mcpUrlFailed: Couldn’t load the Cockpit Context server address.

flags.allowPropose: Allow this agent to propose packages
flags.allowProposeHint: It can ask you to add a package it needs. Each proposal waits for you on the Proposals page.
flags.autoApproveHint: Its proposals become packages without waiting for you. Packages that need an SSH key always wait.
flags.saveFailed: Couldn’t save that change. Try again.

secret.title: Copy this token now
secret.description: It’s shown only once. Cockpit Context keeps only a hash, so it can’t show it again. If you lose it, revoke it and create another.

tokens.title: MCP API tokens
tokens.description: A token lets an agent connect to Cockpit Context as you without signing in.
tokens.preferOAuth: Agents that can sign in can use OAuth instead.

empty.title: No tokens yet
empty.body: Create a token for an agent that can’t sign in with OAuth, or for a script.

create.title: Create an MCP token
create.description: Name it after the agent or machine that will use it, so you can tell tokens apart.
create.failed: Couldn’t create the token. Try again.

created.title: Your new token
created.description: Add it to your agent with one of these, then close this dialog.
created.claudeCodeHint: Add --scope user to use it in every project. Don’t commit a token to a shared .mcp.json.
created.codexHint: Run these commands in the shell that will launch Codex. The token lasts for that shell session; store it securely for future sessions and keep it out of shared files.

form.name: Name
form.nameHint: For example, the laptop or CI job that will use it.

rename.title: Rename token
rename.description: The name is only for you. The token itself doesn’t change.
rename.failed: Couldn’t rename the token. Try again.

revoke.title: Revoke this token?
revoke.description: Any agent using it is cut off at once. This can’t be undone.
revoke.typePrompt: Type the token’s name to confirm
revoke.failed: Couldn’t revoke the token. Try again.

connections.title: OAuth connections
connections.description: Agents you approved on the Cockpit Context consent page. Each acts as you, within its flags.

empty.title: No connections yet
empty.body: Follow the steps above. Once you approve an agent, it appears here.

guide.title: Connect Claude Code with OAuth
guide.description: No token to copy: Claude Code signs in through your browser.
guide.add: Add Cockpit Context in a terminal
guide.authenticateBody: Run /mcp, pick Cockpit Context and choose Authenticate. Your browser opens Cockpit Context.
guide.approveBody: Check the agent’s name and where your browser returns, choose its flags, then allow it.
guide.otherClientsBody: Use this URL in any client that supports MCP authorization.
guide.useToken: Clients that can’t sign in can use a token.

revoke.title: Revoke this connection?
revoke.description: The agent is cut off at once. To reconnect, it has to sign in and be approved again.
revoke.typePrompt: Type the agent’s name to confirm
revoke.failed: Couldn’t revoke the connection. Try again.

sshKeys.title: SSH keys
sshKeys.description: Cockpit Context clones private repositories over SSH. Add a key’s public half to your git host as a read-only deploy key.

empty.title: No SSH keys yet
empty.body: Generate a key in Cockpit Context, or import one you already use. Private keys are encrypted and never shown again.

deployKey.title: Add it to your git host
deployKey.body: Paste the public key as a deploy key with read access on each private repository.

generate.title: Generate an SSH key
generate.description: Cockpit Context creates an Ed25519 key pair and keeps the private half encrypted.
generate.failed: Couldn’t generate the key. Try again.
generate.createdDescription: Copy the public key to your git host. You can see it again from the key’s menu.

import.title: Import an SSH key
import.description: Paste an OpenSSH or PEM private key. Cockpit Context re-encrypts it under its own key and never shows it again.
import.failed: Couldn’t import the key. Try again.

form.name: Name
form.nameHint: For example, the host or repositories it opens.
form.privateKeyHint: The whole file, including the BEGIN and END lines.
form.privateKeyTooLong: That’s too long to be a private key.
form.passphraseHint: Only if the key has one. It’s used once to decrypt the key and isn’t stored.
form.passphraseTooLong: Passphrases longer than 1023 bytes are not supported.
form.passphraseLineBreak: Passphrases with line breaks are not supported.

view.description: The public half of this key. The private half stays encrypted on the server.

delete.title: Delete this SSH key?
delete.description: Cockpit Context forgets the key for good. Packages that still use it must be switched to another key first.
delete.typePrompt: Type the key’s name to confirm
delete.failed: Couldn’t delete the key. Try again.

knownHosts.title: Known hosts
knownHosts.description: Before Cockpit Context clones from a self-hosted git server over SSH, you confirm that server’s host key.

empty.title: No hosts confirmed yet
empty.body: GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket are trusted already. Add your own git server here.

scan.title: Add a git host
scan.description: Cockpit Context connects to the host and lists the SSH keys it offers, for you to compare.
scan.failed: Couldn’t scan that host. Try again.

form.hostHint: A host name, or paste an SSH git URL.
form.hostInvalid: Enter a host name such as git.example.com.

review.title: Keys offered by {{host}}
review.description: Trust only keys whose fingerprints match the ones your git host publishes.
review.pinnedBody: {{host}} is built in: Cockpit Context already trusts its published keys.
review.compare: Compare each fingerprint with the one your git host’s admin or documentation publishes. A key that doesn’t match could mean someone is intercepting the connection.
review.failed: Couldn’t save that key. Try again.

remove.label: Stop trusting {{host}}
remove.title: Stop trusting this key?
remove.description: Clones from this host fail until you confirm a key again. Fingerprint:
remove.failed: Couldn’t remove the key. Try again.

pinned.title: Built-in hosts
pinned.description: Their published host keys are part of Cockpit Context and can’t be changed here.

empty.title: No packages yet
empty.body: Add a dependency your agents should be able to ask about. Agents can also propose packages; those wait for your approval.
empty.noMatchBody: Try a different name or ecosystem.

pendingBanner.body: They can’t ask about it until you approve it.

form.name: Package name
form.identifierFixed: Agents use this to name the package. It can’t be changed.
form.displayNameHint: Optional. Defaults to the package name.
form.gitUrlHint: An https:// URL for public repositories, or an SSH URL (git@host:owner/repo) for private ones.
form.sshKeyHint: Add its public key to the repository as a read-only deploy key.
form.sshKeyRequired: Choose the SSH key that can read this repository.
form.noSshKeys: You don’t have an SSH key yet
form.noSshKeysBody: SSH URLs need a key that can read the repository.
form.subdirectoryHint: For monorepos: the package’s folder. The agent still sees the whole repository but starts here.
form.subdirectoryInvalid: Use a relative folder inside the repository, like packages/core.
form.tagPatternHint: Optional. How release tags are named, with {version}. Tried first when an agent asks for a version.
form.defaultRefHint: Optional. Used when an agent gives no version. Empty means the remote’s default branch.
form.notesHint: Optional. Context the agent reads before every investigation of this package.

lookup.noRepository: The registry doesn’t list a repository. Enter the git URL yourself.
lookup.notFound: Not found on {{registry}}. Check the name, or enter the git URL yourself.
lookup.unavailable: {{registry}} didn’t answer. Try again, or enter the git URL yourself.
lookup.failed: Couldn’t look that package up. Try again.
lookup.gitHint: Git packages have no registry. Name them owner/repo and give the git URL.

create.title: Add a package
create.description: Point Cockpit Context at a dependency’s source. Look it up on its registry to fill in the details.
create.failed: Couldn’t add that package. Try again.

edit.title: Edit package
edit.description: Changes apply to the next question. A new git URL or key re-checks the repository.
edit.failed: Couldn’t save the package. Try again.

delete.title: Delete this package?
delete.description: Agents won’t be able to ask about it. Its conversations stay in your history.
delete.failed: Couldn’t delete the package. Try again.

detail.settingsBody: Where Cockpit Context gets the source, and what the agent should know.
detail.notCloned: Not cloned yet. The first question clones it.
detail.conversationsBody: The latest questions about this package.
detail.noConversationsBody: Ask about this package here, or let your agent ask over MCP.

snapshot.hint: The key is used only for this operation unless you choose to save it. Snapshots stay at their current refs until you update them with your key. Keep your key somewhere safe.
snapshot.save: Save this key to my SSH keys
snapshot.failed: Couldn’t update the snapshot. Try again.
snapshot.deleteWarning: This snapshot cannot be restored without your SSH key. Its conversations keep the package name.

checkouts.title: Versions checked out
checkouts.description: Each version an agent asked about, with the overview the agent reads first. Checkouts are a cache: deleting one frees space, and the next question re-creates it.
checkouts.emptyBody: The first question about a version checks it out here.

refresh.notCloned: Not cloned yet. The next question clones the latest version.
refresh.failed: Couldn’t fetch the repository. Try again.

summary.title: Overview of {{version}}
summary.modelNote: Written by the model from the source and shared by everyone who uses this version. The agent verifies it with its tools.
summary.overrideNote: Edited by you. Your investigations read this instead of the model-written overview. Nobody else sees it.
summary.overrideInUse: Your investigations use your edited version instead of this one.
summary.generatedPending: A new model-written overview is being written.
summary.editDescription: Your edited version is private: only your investigations read it, before every investigation of this version. The model-written overview stays as it is for everyone else.
summary.label: Overview
summary.markdownHint: Markdown. Keep it short: what the code does, key paths, main APIs.
summary.saved: Your version is saved. Your investigations use it from now on.
summary.saveFailed: Couldn’t save the overview. Try again.
summary.revertDescription: Your edited version is deleted, and your investigations use the model-written overview again.
summary.reverted: Reverted. Your investigations use the model-written overview.
summary.revertFailed: Couldn’t revert the overview. Try again.
summary.regenerateNote: Regenerating writes a new model-written overview for everyone who uses this version, using model tokens. It never changes your edited version.
summary.regenerating: Writing a new overview. It appears here when it’s ready.
summary.regeneratingKeepsEdit: Writing a new model-written overview. Your edited version stays as it is, and your investigations keep using it.
summary.alreadyRunning: An overview is already being written.
summary.regenerateFailed: Couldn’t start a new overview. Try again.

delete.leased: In use by a running question
delete.title: Delete the checkout of {{version}}?
delete.description: This frees its disk space. Its conversations stay readable, and the next question about this version checks it out again.
delete.typePrompt: Type the short commit to confirm:
delete.failed: Couldn’t delete the checkout. Try again.

ask.title: Ask about {{identifier}}
ask.description: Cockpit Context reads the source at the version you pick and answers here. This uses model tokens.
ask.question: Your question
ask.questionPlaceholder: How do I retry a failed request with backoff?
ask.defaultBranch: Uses the latest commit on the remote’s default branch.
ask.versionHint: A released version, like 5.2.0. Cockpit Context finds its tag.
ask.refHint: Any git ref: a tag, a branch name or a commit hash.
ask.valueRequired: Enter a version or a ref, or choose Default.
ask.resolving: Finding that version. The first question about a package clones its repository, which can take a minute.
ask.failed: Couldn’t start the investigation. Try again.
ask.nearestTags: Tags close to that version. Pick one to ask about it:
ask.aiDisclosure: Cockpit Context’s answers are written by an AI model. They can be wrong: check the cited files.

proposals.title: Proposals
proposals.description: Packages your agents asked to add. Approve to add them, or reject with a reason the agent can read.
proposals.emptyPendingBody: When an agent proposes a package, it shows up here for your review.
proposals.emptyHistoryBody: Approved and rejected proposals are kept here.

approve.title: Approve this package
approve.description: Check the agent’s suggestions and change anything before adding it.
approve.existing: Approved. {{identifier}} was already in your packages.
approve.failed: Couldn’t approve that proposal. Try again.

reject.title: Reject this proposal?
reject.description: {{identifier}} won’t be added. The agent sees that you rejected it.
reject.reasonHint: Optional. The agent can read it, so say what it should do instead.
reject.failed: Couldn’t reject that proposal. Try again.

notFound.title: Conversation not found
notFound.description: It may have been deleted, or it belongs to another account.

conversation.truncated: This conversation is very long: only its first runs and turns are shown.
conversation.aiDisclosure: Answers are written by an AI model reading the package’s source. They can be wrong: check the cited files before relying on them.

stopReasons.max-iterations: It reached its step limit before finishing.
stopReasons.output-truncated: The model’s reply was cut off.
stopReasons.aborted: It was stopped before it finished.
stopReasons.vetoed: A safety check ended the run.
stopReasons.checkout-failed: The package’s checkout couldn’t be prepared, or was removed while the run used it.
stopReasons.model-error: The model provider returned an error. Try again in a moment.
stopReasons.engine-error: Something went wrong on the server.
stopReasons.interrupted: The server restarted while it was running.

composer.steerHint: The agent reads your message at its next step. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line.
composer.followUpHint: Starts a new run in this conversation, reading the same version. It is not sent to your coding agent.
composer.recreateNotice: This version’s checkout was removed to save space. A follow-up re-creates it first, which can take a moment.

disabled.preparing: Getting the checkout ready. You can steer once the agent starts.
disabled.recreating: Re-creating this version’s checkout. You can steer once the agent starts.
disabled.finishing: The agent is writing its final answer, so it can’t take new instructions. Ask a follow-up once it finishes.
disabled.packageDeleted: This package was deleted, so this conversation can’t continue.

composer.steerTooLate: The agent has already finished its investigation. Ask a follow-up instead; your text is still in the box.
composer.alreadyRunning: A run is already in progress in this conversation.
composer.failed: Couldn’t send your message. Try again.

delete.title: Delete this conversation?
delete.description: Its question, answers, tool calls and helper runs are deleted for good.

empty.title: No conversations yet
empty.description: Questions your agents ask over MCP, and ones you ask from a package page, appear here.

retention.loadFailed: Couldn’t load how long conversations are kept.
retention.deletedAfter_one: Conversations are deleted {{count}} day after their last activity.
retention.deletedAfter_other: Conversations are deleted {{count}} days after their last activity.
retention.keptUntilDeleted: Conversations are kept until you delete them.
